svg.aria-label: Architecture: a new issue, the repository and its code graph go to one offline Gemma 4 triage agent, which writes notes, a reproduction script and a trace. A deterministic orchestrator falls back when notes are missing, computes confidence from agreement with retrieval, finds tests through call edges and re-runs the reproduction. It fills the final report for a maintainer, who can add a hint and re-run.
svg.title: Gemma 4 Issue Triage architecture

svg.text: One offline Gemma 4 agent investigates. Deterministic code checks every claim. A maintainer decides.
